items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Because Tillman told me, not Tillman, Bill Matthews told me

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, how do they select the pallbearers for the different people like John Casimir? I was looking at the picture. Yeah.

Well, I'll tell you what to do. During the week, they'll come around with a list and ask you if you want to be pallbearers. Yeah. Yeah. And sometime before a man die, maybe he might select, you know, ask, can you help? I want you all to be. Yeah. Yeah. Because Tillman told me, not Tillman, Bill Matthews told me, when I die, I want you to be my pallbearer. And I was, I did it. Yeah. Bill Matthews, the man told me, when I die, John, I want you to be my pallbearer. He knew he was going.
He was thin as a rail. He looked awful. He could cancel.
